description: This file defines a command-line command 'tail-log' that tails the most recent log lines from the TranscriptsStore in an asynchronous manner.

classes.name: TailLogCommand
classes.description: A command-line command conforming to ParsableCommand that outputs the most recent transcript lines.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves and prints the last 10 lines from the transcripts store.
